summary.business_type: Hybrid Local Service (Farm + Restaurant + Butcher + E-commerce)
top_findings: Missing security headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, CSP) on all pages
No Google API credentials configured — CWV field data unavailable
Duplicate structured data blocks (Organization+AggregateRating appears twice)
AI training crawlers blocked but AI search citability crawlers allowed — good strategy
Sitemap lastmod dates are stale for some pages (2026-11-18 vs recent deploys)
quick_wins: Add HSTS header via Cloudflare dashboard or _headers file
Deduplicate Organization schema block in homepage head
Update sitemap lastmod to reflect actual deploy dates
Configure Google API key for CrUX field data

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All key pages return HTTP 200 with correct content-type
robots.txt properly configured with AI crawler segmentation
Sitemap.xml present with all major routes including /market
Cloudflare CDN with gzip compression enabled
Clean URL structure with semantic paths

findings.title: Missing HSTS header
findings.description: No Strict-Transport-Security header detected on any page. Site serves over HTTPS but without HSTS, browsers may still attempt HTTP connections.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains' via Cloudflare _headers file or dashboard

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options and CSP headers
findings.description: No X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, or Content-Security-Policy headers detected. Site is vulnerable to clickjacking and MIME sniffing.
findings.recommendation: Add security headers via public/_headers: X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff

findings.title: No cache-control headers on HTML pages
findings.description: HTML responses lack explicit Cache-Control directives. Cloudflare defaults apply but browser caching is uncontrolled.
findings.recommendation: Add Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate for HTML pages via _headers

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage extracted text is 3509 chars — substantial content
Multi-section narrative structure (Storia, Luogo, Filiera, Tavola, Voce)
Dedicated pages for each business vertical (allevamento, caseificio, macelleria, agriturismo, market)
FAQ page present for long-tail queries
Recensioni page for social proof

findings.title: Some sitemap pages have stale lastmod dates
findings.description: Pages /prodotti, /chi-siamo, /dove-siamo, /recensioni show lastmod 2026-11-18 while others show 2026-11-26. If content was updated more recently, search engines may not re-crawl.
findings.recommendation: Ensure sitemap generation uses actual file modification timestamps, not hardcoded dates

findings.title: Market page meta description may reference old category names
findings.description: After renaming legumi→panificio and updating salumi/farine, verify the meta description in market.tsx head() reflects current categories.
findings.recommendation: Audit meta description text in src/routes/market.tsx head() function

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Semantic URL structure (/allevamento, /caseificio, /macelleria, /agriturismo, /market)
Canonical URLs set via getAbsoluteUrl()
Open Graph tags present on key pages
Breadcrumb component available for navigation context

findings.title: Verify /bottega → /market redirect preserves link equity
findings.description: Route was renamed from /bottega to /market. A 301 redirect exists in public/_redirects but should be verified live to ensure proper status code and destination.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: 3 valid JSON-LD blocks detected on homepage
FoodEstablishment + Restaurant + LocalBusiness types present
GeoCoordinates included for local SEO
AggregateRating schema present for social proof

findings.title: Duplicate Organization+AggregateRating blocks
findings.description: Two identical JSON-LD blocks with Organization+AggregateRating types detected (blocks 2 and 3, both 490 bytes). Duplicate structured data wastes crawl budget and may confuse parsers.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate into a single Organization block or differentiate with @id references

findings.title: Market page may lack Product schema
findings.description: E-commerce /market page with 35 products likely lacks per-product JSON-LD. Product schema enables rich results in search.
findings.recommendation: Add Product JSON-LD for top products or ItemList schema for the catalog page

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Cloudflare CDN with gzip compression
Three.js dynamically imported (lazy-loaded) to avoid blocking homepage
Images use loading='lazy' and decoding='async' attributes
Shared WebGL renderer pattern reduces GPU context switches

findings.title: No CrUX field data available
findings.description: Google API credentials not configured. Cannot assess real-world LCP, INP, CLS from Chrome UX Report. Lab estimates only.
findings.recommendation: Configure GOOGLE_API_KEY to unlock CrUX field data for accurate CWV assessment

findings.title: Homepage HTML is 141KB uncompressed
findings.description: Raw HTML payload is 141,223 chars. With gzip this compresses well, but large initial HTML can delay first paint on slow connections.
findings.recommendation: Consider streaming SSR or reducing inline content; verify compressed size via curl

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt explicitly allows OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ChatGPT-User
AI training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Bytespider, CCBot) correctly blocked
Structured data provides machine-readable entity definitions
Semantic URL structure aids AI citation

findings.title: No llms.txt or .well-known/ai-plugin.json discovery
findings.description: While ai-plugin.json exists at /.well-known/, no llms.txt at root for AI agent discovery. Emerging standard for AI-readable site summaries.
findings.recommendation: Add /llms.txt with site summary, key pages, and contact info for AI agent consumption

categories.name: Images
what_works: Product images use lazy loading and async decoding
Explicit width/height attributes prevent CLS
Placeholder images in place for all product categories

findings.title: Placeholder images may lack descriptive alt text
findings.description: Product images use placeholder paths. When real photos are added, alt text must be descriptive for accessibility and image search.
findings.recommendation: Ensure all product.immagine values have corresponding meaningful alt text in component rendering
